summary: NextBoat Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Master Loan Agreement with RLLT Capital, LLC to finance pre-owned boat inventory. The initial $2.0 million loan bears 15% simple interest, matures in 180 days, with a one-time 90-day extension at a 2% premium, plus a 1% origination fee and 5% profit participation. The loans are full-recourse, unsecured, and jointly and severally obligated. President Jason Ruegg provided a personal guaranty and stock pledge of at least $5 million collateral without consideration, deemed by the board to be in the company's best interest. This is an ordinary commercial financing arrangement, not a special situation.
